decisions.quote: The hypothesis of the replication – the Russian leaners of English would demonstrate pragmatic failure in the responses to “How are you?” as rated by the NS judges – was not supported.
decisions.reason: Jaworski (1994) found that EFL learners exhibited pragmatic failure when responding to English greetings, whereas this replication found that Russian EFL learners achieved pragmatic success and concluded that the replication hypothesis of pragmatic failure was not supported and the results differed significantly from Jaworski's. The shipped coding mistook the participants' pragmatic success for a successful replication outcome.

parent_source_inspection.note: Authors explicitly say replication hypothesis pragmatic failure not supported; participant pragmatic success is a contradiction, hence failed replication.
